title: Filolial Fever
paragraphs: So, that’s how our leveling run on Cal Mira Island began. While we’re at it, we’ll also have to research the motorboard form of Drive Mode so we can fight underwater. Nah, I get the feeling it’ll be easy enough if we make good use of things like the Windmill.

Ah… it sounds like fun to ride across The Great Deep like a motorboat with Filo-tan on my back. Or maybe the “surface-skimming” style—where you put your left foot forward before your right foot sinks—would be better…? I’ve heard that Filo-tan used to ask Father to do that for her.

I could do that too if I put my mind to it, but it’s a bit of a hassle in many ways. Or perhaps the deep-diving style that Big Sister’s older sister used to do… developing a “submarine mode” sounds like a good idea too. The method is the same, after all. There’s so much to do on Cal Mira Island—it’s really fun!

So, we threw ourselves into life on Cal Mira Island. Ah, and of course, peeping in the hot springs is a must. Even though Éclair and Father say it’s off-limits, the staff here are used to peeping, so I can easily fulfill Yuki-chan’s requests.

After all, once peace returned, Father used these hot springs as his public bath, so I know everything about the layout inside and out. Years later, on Father’s orders, the moles carried out major expansions and renovations that made peeping harder, but at this stage, it’s a breeze.
With the sunset behind us, Yuki-chan and I will play tag on the beach.
“Ahahaha… Motoyasu-sama—over here!”
Yuki-chan looks like she’s having a blast. Ufufu… Ahahahaha… that’s the spirit!
“Wait up!”
Father, who’s been searching for Ren at the harbor day after day and is quite exhausted, is watching this scene.
“That sort of thing… I don’t know how to put it, but it’s just so Motoyasu-kun, I guess… It’s a bit too cliché, or maybe it’s just that he finds joy in everything…”
“Hey, Naofumi, I want to try that too. Would it be fun to do it with Sakura-chan?”
“It looks like it would be fun just as a simple game of tag. Though, in Motoyasu-kun’s case, it’s a little different, you know…”
“Judging by the way he’s playing around with Lord Yuki like that, I think Lord Kitamura is quite the hero himself…”
Éclair is also muttering something to herself as she stands with Father, the evening sun warming their cheeks. It’s fun, so isn’t that enough?
“He’s acting just like a hero from a cliché shoujo manga, isn’t he?”
“Personally, I’m more concerned about the dust swirling up behind them… Just how hard are they stomping the ground?”
Yuki-chan is fast, after all. To keep up with her, you’d have to really put some power into your legs.
“It’s not like they’re doing running drills on the sand… is it?”
“No way. I’d rather not come all the way to a southern island just for training. We do that regularly before coming here, don’t we? It’s way more entertaining to watch Elmero go to the beach.”
“Well, Elmero… he’s pretty heavy, so it’s probably hard for him to move.”
“It’s not that I don’t want to… If I use Magic to harden the ground, there’s no problem running on it. Besides, I just went swimming with Kou a little while ago.”
“Elmero can swim with just his nose sticking out of the water—Kou, I’m so jealous!”
“Well… I’m just glad everyone’s having fun in their own way.”

It seems Father and the others are enjoying their days on Cal Mira Island just like that. By the way, when Father went out hunting, he managed to snag a penguin costume right away. He’s got some luck, doesn’t he? I often get rabbit costumes, but the other ones don’t come up very often.

We had a great time on Cal Mira Island—playing tag with Yuki-chan and hanging out with the other Filolial-samas. Along the way, we ran into Panda out hunting with his subordinates. You can tell right away because of the bamboo grove.
“Hey, you lot! I hope your skills haven’t gotten rusty!”
“‘Yes, ma’am!’”
“Let’s go!”

The panda led the charge and attacked the monsters. Then she threw a bottle of sake; before it hit the monsters, her subordinates used the momentum from the bamboo to leap at them and launch a flurry of attacks. After pulling back, the panda hurled fire at them, setting the monsters ablaze.
“All done! You guys’ moves have really improved—I’ll give you credit for that.”
“Big Sis! We’re so grateful!”
Whoa, that was quite a flashy attack.
“Wow! So cool!”
The Filolial-sama I’m raising is completely captivated by the scene.
“How barbaric… It may be efficient, but it’s certainly not elegant.”
It seems Yuki-chan isn’t a fan. Well, you know. It might just be Panda’s trump card.
“So, Big Sis, what if we incorporate Bon the Shield into this combo?”
When her subordinate made that suggestion, the Panda furrowed her brows deeply.
“Why do we have to include that guy in this combo?”
“I just thought if I showed it to him, he’d want to join in!”
“…Ah, yeah. He’d probably get all excited with his eyes sparkling.”

It’s Father’s innocence that keeps him from forgetting the heart of a dreamy young boy. Father from the first world wouldn’t give me that kind of look! Well, actually, I get the feeling he’d just watch with a look of disinterest. Like… staring off into space.
“Since the Spear Hero is right there, I imagine he’ll be reported.”
When the panda’s subordinate points at us, the panda makes a face like, “Oh no!”
“Hey, Spear Hero. What’s up? You’re staring right at us.”
“Aren’t you going to practice your moves with Father?”

I think Father actually quite enjoys this kind of teamwork. After all, he always worked in perfect sync with Big Sister. Usually, Father would pin down the opponent’s movements, and Big Sister would attack while they were off-balance. I imagine the Panda’s combo attack works much the same way.
“Where exactly does a Shield Hero who can’t attack fit into this combo?”
“If you take on the role of restraining the enemy’s movements, the success rate will go up, won’t it?”
“If that happens, you might end up getting caught in the final burst of flames.”
“Father would walk right out of the flames without batting an eye.”
“Spear Hero, do you really idolize that guy?”
The Panda is giving me a suspicious look.
“Of course. I’m sure Father would emerge unscathed.”
I’m sure that even if I unleashed Liberation Firestorm X with all my might, he’d walk right out of the flames with a completely unfazed expression.
“That’s what I call trust.”
“No matter how much it can take, though… I’m not sure that’s the best idea, is it?”
“Well then, it’s the skill that summons a shield cage the moment the fire ignites. If you trap the flames inside that, you can contain them just right.”
“That’s pretty brutal… Well, I guess that might actually be the better option.”
That’s pretty much how it went.

As for the rest, well… We’ll be searching for and destroying the monsters that appear on the ever-familiar Cal Mira Island to level up Filolial-sama as much as possible. Of course, it’s a given that Father will scold me for hunting too much. It’s a fun vacation, isn’t it?

To help the adventurers blow off some steam, Filolial-sama held live shows day and night on the central island as part of her idol activities. Led by Yuki-chan, these local live performances drew not only the adventurers but also fans, making the island even more lively.
“Thank you all so much! I’d be thrilled if you came back tomorrow!”
Yuki-chan’s fans waved glow sticks in time with the music, making the live show on Cal Mira Island shine even brighter.
“…Lord Iwatani, I hope it’s just my imagination, but I get the feeling the buildings on the island we’re using as our base are gradually being expanded and turning into some kind of strange complex…”
“Yeah… you’re right. Not only are opportunistic businesses running rampant… but it’s starting to feel less like the rough-and-tumble vibe of adventurers and more like a town filled with otaku.”
“There’s no doubt it’s different from Zeltoble, too… How could it change this much in just a few days?”
Father-in-law and the others mutter this while watching the apparently very popular concert by Filolial-sama. Incidentally, the venue is fully visible from the hotel window, offering a superb view.
“Yes. According to the information I’ve gathered, it’s known as ‘the island where you can meet beautiful girls,’ and… word of mouth is bringing in more and more people, while fewer are leaving.”
Zou adds. This is further proof that the place is buzzing with energy.
“It’s so popular right now that there are entry restrictions, yet they’re still managing to pull this off… even though the other islands are much less crowded compared to this one.”
Panda replies, sounding a bit exasperated.
“I don’t think everyone here is a Filolial fan… but hearing Motoyasu-kun’s goal of beating Gaelion-chan, it might not be such a far-fetched idea after all.”
“I’d like to think it’s just a temporary phenomenon drawn on by the island’s atmosphere.”
“Or maybe it’ll even spread from here. Won’t people start calling it ‘Filolial Island’ instead of ‘Cal Mira Island’?”

“That sounds scary enough to be plausible… I wouldn’t even be able to relax in the hot springs… I mean, it’s the kind of situation where fans would all line up at the partition of the men’s bath at once.”

By the way, it seems that whenever Yuki-chan and the others try to take a bath, some fans go wild and try to sneak a peek. Just peeking is one thing, but if they openly barge in, they’ll face severe punishment. And if they do peek, the punishment is all part of the package. The aesthetic of the peeping tom! The entire process—right up to receiving punishment—is an essential part of the ritual.
“Lord Iwatani, could you please warn Lord Kitamura and see if we can drive those people out? We can’t relax when it’s become acceptable for people to casually peek into the women’s baths.”
“If they’d just listen to reason, it wouldn’t be such a hassle. Motoyasu-kun has his moments when he’ll listen—and moments when he won’t…”
“…That’s true… My apologies.”
“Well… Technically, they’ll be arrested and exiled from the island, but even so, the number of visitors keeps rising and rising… Where did the restrictions go?”
“The nobles in charge of managing this island have their eyes on the money, haven’t they? I wonder just how much they’re raking in.”
“I feel like I heard the count’s laughter near the Throne Room inside the hotel.”
“…In Zeltoble, we call unscrupulous merchants who desecrate life ‘Merchants of Death.’ I’m starting to get that vibe from that noble.”
“To have come this far in just a few days… The Hero’s influence is truly terrifying.”
“I’d like to say it’s thanks to Filolial, who brought so many people here.”
That’s the kind of vibe the island has right now—it’s Filolial Fever! And so, our days on Cal Mira Island passed by.

Eventually, at the count’s suggestion, the Filolial-sama were introduced to inns on each island and used them as bases to hold live performances across the region. This helped disperse the fans, and people scattered to their respective islands.

Incidentally, thanks to the countless Filolial-sama, the number of monsters on the island decreased significantly, resolving the problem of overcrowding in the hunting grounds that had been causing trouble. Father and I had the job of processing the mountain of monsters they brought back.

And so, we spent our time on the island until the revitalization of Cal Mira Island was complete. When we were about to leave the island, the nobles spoke earnestly, desperately trying to keep us there. They even went so far as to say they wanted a certain number of the Filolial-sama to remain as part of the island’s industry.

Nothing like this had ever happened in any of our previous runs. For the time being, we promised that Filolial-sama would take turns stationing themselves there, and that settled the matter for the moment.
“It looks like this place, not Shieldfreeden, is going to become the holy site…”
Father muttered, but let’s just call this a pilgrimage site for the event. Heh heh heh… Our idol activities were a huge success. We’ve taken over Cal Mira Island. There’s no room for Rival here.
Those fun days on the island passed by… but as for the Refining, which was our original goal, neither Father found any at the port, nor did I or the pandas find any at the hunting grounds.
“…Hmm…”
On the deck of the return ship, Father is groaning as he stares in the direction of Cal Mira Island.
“I really thought Ren—the one Motoyasu-kun told me about—would definitely show up… Especially since it was such a great opportunity to level up…”
“Perhaps he’s already reached a stage where he doesn’t need to level up on Cal Mira Island anymore.”

It would indeed be strange for that Ren to pass up this opportunity. To begin with, even though we were told to look for him in Zeltoble, he’s nowhere to be found. Of course, we tried to make contact through various merchants and informants. But there’s absolutely no sign of him. According to reports, there was someone who looked like Ren in Zeltoble, but his whereabouts since then are unknown.
“I just… can’t shake this bad feeling. We’ve got to find Ren soon…”
Seriously! Where on earth is Ren wandering off to? It’s hopeless how he keeps causing trouble for Father. Next time we find him, we’ll have to make sure he can’t escape.
